source_text: Don’t act so surprised, 1Hero. You’ve seen it before.

structure.raw_value: LiFlOp.Don’t act so surprised, 1Hero. You’ve seen it before.
structure.script_literal: "LiFlOp.Don’t act so surprised, 1Hero. You’ve seen it before."

translation: Nie udawaj takiego zdziwionego, 1Hero. Już tu byłeś.

source_text: We have time before dinner. I’d love to chat before the food is ready.

structure.raw_value: LiFrEx.We have time before dinner. I’d love to chat before the food is ready.
structure.script_literal: "LiFrEx.We have time before dinner. I’d love to chat before the food is ready."

translation: Mamy czas przed kolacją. Chętnie porozmawiam, zanim jedzenie będzie gotowe.

source_text: I feel safer knowing I have the police guarding my home. But I can’t help but worry about my father’s reputation if people find out what’s going on.

structure.raw_value: LiSaEx.I feel safer knowing I have the police guarding my home. But I can’t help but worry about my father’s reputation if people find out what’s going on.
structure.script_literal: "LiSaEx.I feel safer knowing I have the police guarding my home. But I can’t help but worry about my father’s reputation if people find out what’s going on."

translation: Czuję się bezpieczniej, wiedząc, że policja pilnuje domu. Ale nie mogę nie martwić się o reputację ojca, jeśli ludzie dowiedzą się, co się dzieje.

source_text: Your safety is the most important thing now. Your father’s past may not be able to remain hidden forever.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Your safety is the most important thing now. Your father’s past may not be able to remain hidden forever.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Your safety is the most important thing now. Your father’s past may not be able to remain hidden forever."

translation: Twoje bezpieczeństwo jest teraz najważniejsze. Przeszłości twojego ojca nie da się ukrywać wiecznie.

source_text: If you find another secret passage, I want to see it.

structure.raw_value: ErFrOp.If you find another secret passage, I want to see it.
structure.script_literal: "ErFrOp.If you find another secret passage, I want to see it."

translation: Jeśli znajdziesz kolejne tajne przejście, chcę je zobaczyć.

source_text: I’ve got the key, but I don’t know what it opens.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.I’ve got the key, but I don’t know what it opens.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.I’ve got the key, but I don’t know what it opens."

translation: Mam klucz, ale nie wiem, co otwiera.

source_text: It’s got to be something outside.

structure.raw_value: ErBaDe.It’s got to be something outside.

translation: To musi być coś na zewnątrz.

source_text: Would I make a good detective?

structure.raw_value: ErFrOp.Would I make a good detective?

source_text: Come on, let’s go outside and take a look.

structure.raw_value: ErHaEx.Come on, let’s go outside and take a look.
structure.script_literal: "ErHaEx.Come on, let’s go outside and take a look."

translation: Chodź, wyjdźmy na zewnątrz i poszukajmy.

source_text: We can’t go far. The forest behind the mansion is very dense.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.We can’t go far. The forest behind the mansion is very dense.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.We can’t go far. The forest behind the mansion is very dense."

translation: Nie możemy zajść daleko. Las za rezydencją jest bardzo gęsty.

source_text: Go in there and get them to move away from the kitchen hall.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Go in there and get them to move away from the kitchen hall.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Go in there and get them to move away from the kitchen hall."

translation: Wejdź tam i spraw, żeby odeszli od korytarza przy kuchni.

source_text: I didn’t think that far ahead… Just… Waggle your butt.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.I didn’t think that far ahead… Just… Waggle your butt.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.I didn’t think that far ahead… Just… Waggle your butt."

translation: Nie pomyślałam tak daleko… Po prostu… Pokręć tyłkiem.

source_text: Ugh… Can you make a scene? Fall down or something?

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.Ugh… Can you make a scene? Fall down or something?
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.Ugh… Can you make a scene? Fall down or something?"

translation: Ugh… Możesz zrobić scenę? Przewrócić się czy coś?

source_text: You know… Those leper dudes almost blew their lids last time I tried to spruce this place up with flowers.

structure.raw_value: ErBaEx.You know… Those leper dudes almost blew their lids last time I tried to spruce this place up with flowers.
structure.script_literal: "ErBaEx.You know… Those leper dudes almost blew their lids last time I tried to spruce this place up with flowers."

translation: Wiesz… Ci kolesie w maskach prawie eksplodowali, gdy ostatnio próbowałam ozdobić to miejsce kwiatami.

source_text: No… It’s the candles… Apparently the yellow flower I wanted to put in the room was a fire hazard.

structure.raw_value: ErBaEx.No… It’s the candles… Apparently the yellow flower I wanted to put in the room was a fire hazard.
structure.script_literal: "ErBaEx.No… It’s the candles… Apparently the yellow flower I wanted to put in the room was a fire hazard."

translation: Nie… Chodzi o świece… Podobno żółty kwiat, który chciałam wstawić, był zagrożeniem pożarowym.

source_text: They are talking about the Acacia flower… Its oils are highly flammable.

structure.raw_value: McFlEx.They are talking about the Acacia flower… Its oils are highly flammable.
structure.script_literal: "McFlEx.They are talking about the Acacia flower… Its oils are highly flammable."

translation: Mówią o kwiecie akacji… Jego olejki są wysoce łatwopalne.

source_text: So… How does that help us?

structure.raw_value: ErBaDe.So… How does that help us?

source_text: Just a small one. They’ll have to react to it.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Just a small one. They’ll have to react to it.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Just a small one. They’ll have to react to it."

source_text: We only need a small fire. You three can handle it.

structure.raw_value: McFlEx.We only need a small fire. You three can handle it.
structure.script_literal: "McFlEx.We only need a small fire. You three can handle it."

translation: Potrzebujemy tylko małego ognia. Wy troje dacie radę.

source_text: Okay. If you think it’ll work.

structure.raw_value: ErBaDe.Okay. If you think it’ll work.

source_text: It grows in the forest near water sources. I’ll see if I can find one.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.It grows in the forest near water sources. I’ll see if I can find one.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.It grows in the forest near water sources. I’ll see if I can find one."

translation: Rośnie w lesie blisko źródeł wody. Zobaczę, czy znajdę jedną.

source_text: Did you find the flower in the forest?

structure.raw_value: ErWoEx.Did you find the flower in the forest?
structure.script_literal: "ErWoEx.Did you find the flower in the forest?"

source_text: Not yet. Give me a minute.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Not yet. Give me a minute.

source_text: Get a little too close to the candles and touch them to the fire…

structure.raw_value: McFlEx.Get a little too close to the candles and touch them to the fire…
structure.script_literal: "McFlEx.Get a little too close to the candles and touch them to the fire…"

translation: Podejdź odrobinę za blisko świec i dotknij ich ogniem…

source_text: Then throw it to the ground so you don’t get burnt.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Then throw it to the ground so you don’t get burnt.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Then throw it to the ground so you don’t get burnt."

translation: Potem rzuć go na ziemię, żeby się nie poparzyć.

source_text: What do you need? This area is already clean.

structure.raw_value: HoAnOp>.What do you need? This area is already clean.
structure.script_literal: "HoAnOp>.What do you need? This area is already clean."

translation: Czego potrzebujesz? Tu już jest czysto.

source_text: Are you sure? Maybe I should check.

structure.raw_value: ErHaOp.Are you sure? Maybe I should check.
structure.script_literal: "ErHaOp.Are you sure? Maybe I should check."

source_text: I know where the food storage is. I’ll get this mystery eyeball thing and you start looking for something out of place.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.I know where the food storage is. I’ll get this mystery eyeball thing and you start looking for something out of place.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.I know where the food storage is. I’ll get this mystery eyeball thing and you start looking for something out of place."

translation: Wiem, gdzie jest spiżarnia. Wezmę tę tajemniczą gałkę oczną, a ty zacznij szukać czegoś niepasującego.

source_text: Out of place? This whole mansion is filled with odd-looking things.

structure.raw_value: KiBaDe.Out of place? This whole mansion is filled with odd-looking things.
structure.script_literal: "KiBaDe.Out of place? This whole mansion is filled with odd-looking things."

translation: Niepasującego? Cała rezydencja jest pełna dziwnych rzeczy.

source_text: Just wait here and try not to get seen.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Just wait here and try not to get seen.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Just wait here and try not to get seen."

translation: Po prostu zostań tu i postaraj się nie zostać zauważonym.

source_text: These statues make no sense. They’ve been placed on top of the carpet…

structure.raw_value: KiBaDe.These statues make no sense. They’ve been placed on top of the carpet…
structure.script_literal: "KiBaDe.These statues make no sense. They’ve been placed on top of the carpet…"

translation: Te posągi nie mają sensu. Postawiono je na dywanie…

source_text: This sure is a heavy statue. I can’t move it with my hands.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.This sure is a heavy statue. I can’t move it with my hands.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.This sure is a heavy statue. I can’t move it with my hands."

translation: Ten posąg jest naprawdę ciężki. Nie przesunę go rękami.

source_text: The old man could come back at any moment.

structure.raw_value: ErWoCl.The old man could come back at any moment.
structure.script_literal: "ErWoCl.The old man could come back at any moment."

translation: Stary może wrócić w każdej chwili.

source_text: Could I trust any of you?

structure.raw_value: LiFlOp.Could I trust any of you?

translation: Czy ja mogę ufać któremukolwiek z was?

source_text: There’s going to be a hell of a lot of officers coming down on this mansion if you’re hiding something.

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.There’s going to be a hell of a lot of officers coming down on this mansion if you’re hiding something.
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe.There’s going to be a hell of a lot of officers coming down on this mansion if you’re hiding something."

translation: Zjedzie tu mnóstwo funkcjonariuszy, jeśli coś ukrywasz.

source_text: What are you two standing around for? Go find the girl.

structure.raw_value: AdAnEx.What are you two standing around for? Go find the girl.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnEx.What are you two standing around for? Go find the girl."

translation: Co tak stoicie? Idźcie szukać dziewczyny.
Odejdź, 1Hero. I trzymaj się z daleka.

source_text: I’m not leaving Kimberly inside that rift.

structure.raw_value: McAnOp.I’m not leaving Kimberly inside that rift.
structure.script_literal: "McAnOp.I’m not leaving Kimberly inside that rift."

translation: Nie zostawię Kimberly w tym pęknięciu.

source_text: I’ll send some men down there to retrieve her. She’ll be returned safely.

structure.raw_value: AdAnEx.I’ll send some men down there to retrieve her. She’ll be returned safely.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnEx.I’ll send some men down there to retrieve her. She’ll be returned safely."

translation: Wyślę tam ludzi, żeby ją sprowadzili. Wróci cała i zdrowa.

source_text: That won’t work. She’s not in our world.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.That won’t work. She’s not in our world.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.That won’t work. She’s not in our world."

translation: To nie zadziała. Ona nie jest w naszym świecie.

source_text: We’ll stop Madalyn. This doesn’t concern you.

structure.raw_value: AdAnDe.We’ll stop Madalyn. This doesn’t concern you.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnDe.We’ll stop Madalyn. This doesn’t concern you."

translation: Zatrzymamy Madalyn. To nie twoja sprawa.

source_text: Try and keep everyone away from here. I don’t know how long it’ll take.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Try and keep everyone away from here. I don’t know how long it’ll take.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Try and keep everyone away from here. I don’t know how long it’ll take."

translation: Postaraj się trzymać wszystkich z dala. Nie wiem, ile to potrwa.

source_text: Just… Give us time. Keep Duncan’s men away from us.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.Just… Give us time. Keep Duncan’s men away from us.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.Just… Give us time. Keep Duncan’s men away from us."

translation: Po prostu… daj nam czas. Trzymaj ludzi Duncana z daleka.

source_text: Maybe you’ll get off my ass about the last amulet.

structure.raw_value: DuAnDe.Maybe you’ll get off my ass about the last amulet.
structure.script_literal: "DuAnDe.Maybe you’ll get off my ass about the last amulet."

translation: Może wreszcie odpuścisz mi ten ostatni amulet.
Czy te kawałki skał są cenne?

source_text: More than you can imagine, young man.

structure.raw_value: MlFlEx>.More than you can imagine, young man.
structure.script_literal: "MlFlEx>.More than you can imagine, young man."

translation: Bardziej, niż możesz sobie wyobrazić, młody człowieku.

source_text: Shit. Duncan’s here and he’s given Madalyn the Toma pieces.

structure.raw_value: McWoOp#>.Shit. Duncan’s here and he’s given Madalyn the Toma pieces.
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp#>.Shit. Duncan’s here and he’s given Madalyn the Toma pieces."

translation: Cholera. Duncan już tu jest i oddał Madalyn kawałki Tomy.

source_text: I doubt we can take them… And even if we could… Andrea would be pissed.

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.I doubt we can take them… And even if we could… Andrea would be pissed.
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.I doubt we can take them… And even if we could… Andrea would be pissed."

translation: Wątpię, byśmy dali im radę… A nawet gdyby… Andrea byłaby wściekła.

source_text: Who cares about Duncan? We can take down Madalyn…

structure.raw_value: BrAnEx.Who cares about Duncan? We can take down Madalyn…
structure.script_literal: "BrAnEx.Who cares about Duncan? We can take down Madalyn…"

translation: Kto by się przejmował Duncanem? Możemy dopaść Madalyn…

source_text: We just need to wait until she’s alone.

structure.raw_value: BrBaOp.We just need to wait until she’s alone.
structure.script_literal: "BrBaOp.We just need to wait until she’s alone."

translation: Musimy tylko poczekać, aż zostanie sama.

source_text: I know where she’s going… As soon as they leave, we need to get down there.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.I know where she’s going… As soon as they leave, we need to get down there.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.I know where she’s going… As soon as they leave, we need to get down there."

translation: Wiem, dokąd idzie… Gdy tylko wyjdą, musimy zejść na dół.
Nie ma mowy!... Co tam jest na dole?

source_text: Come on, 1Hero. You can help me look for her.

structure.raw_value: KiHaEx.Come on, 1Hero. You can help me look for her.
structure.script_literal: "KiHaEx.Come on, 1Hero. You can help me look for her."

translation: Chodź, 1Hero. Możesz pomóc mi jej szukać.

source_text: She went into the rift. I don’t know how to open it.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.She went into the rift. I don’t know how to open it.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.She went into the rift. I don’t know how to open it."

translation: Weszła w pęknięcie. Nie wiem, jak je otworzyć.

source_text: How the hell would she know how to do that?

structure.raw_value: McAnOp.How the hell would she know how to do that?
structure.script_literal: "McAnOp.How the hell would she know how to do that?"

translation: Skąd ona, do cholery, miałaby wiedzieć, jak to zrobić?

source_text: I thought I heard a scuffle.

structure.raw_value: MeBaOp.I thought I heard a scuffle.

translation: Zdawało mi się, że słyszałem szamotaninę.

source_text: I didn’t hear anything… But I’ll keep an eye out.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.I didn’t hear anything… But I’ll keep an eye out.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.I didn’t hear anything… But I’ll keep an eye out."

translation: Nic nie słyszałem… Ale będę miał oko.

source_text: How many of those henchmen are left?

structure.raw_value: HrAnOp.How many of those henchmen are left?
structure.script_literal: "HrAnOp.How many of those henchmen are left?"

source_text: That should be all of them.

structure.raw_value: DiBaEx.That should be all of them.

source_text: What the hell do you want?

structure.raw_value: MeMaOp.What the hell do you want?

source_text: You’re relying on him for more men?

structure.raw_value: MeAnOp.You’re relying on him for more men?
structure.script_literal: "MeAnOp.You’re relying on him for more men?"

translation: Liczysz, że dostarczy ci więcej ludzi?

source_text: Your prize awaits you, my children.

structure.raw_value: MlFlEx>.Your prize awaits you, my children.

translation: Nagroda na was czeka, moje dzieci.

source_text: Did that door just shut? Was that Nellie? Is someone else in here?

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.Did that door just shut? Was that Nellie? Is someone else in here?
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.Did that door just shut? Was that Nellie? Is someone else in here?"

translation: Czy te drzwi się właśnie zamknęły? To była Nellie? Jest tu ktoś jeszcze?

source_text: I have to go back for the others.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.I have to go back for the others.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.I have to go back for the others."

source_text: Go down these steps. You’ll be safe.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Go down these steps. You’ll be safe.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Go down these steps. You’ll be safe."

translation: Zejdź po tych schodach. Będziesz bezpieczna.
